scope: Final feature source plus seven fresh browser scenarios; both live preview worlds are still V94 content (242 concepts,332 recipes).
player_outcome: An observed empty combination becomes a dashed, text-labelled partner when its other ingredient is selected. The exact pair appears in feedback; repeating or reversing it within the fresh window keeps focus and adds no request or save mutation.
observations: Baseline repeat sent two combine requests; candidate repeat sent one.
Inspected baseline/mobile and candidate/mobile screenshots: the new dashed marker remains distinct from selected and newly discovered styles; text and accessible name explicitly explain its meaning.

At320px and200% root text, marked labels and feedback wrap without horizontal or vertical clipping; keyboard focus is visible on the tried tile. Longer unrelated ingredient labels break across lines, a pre-existing layout characteristic rather than a new obstruction.
Keyboard Enter/Space, repeated identical acknowledgments and drag all retain the observed-pair safeguard. Choosing a different anchor removes unrelated marks.
Lost committed replies inherit failure memory only from recovery GET. Lost uncommitted requests produce no invented mark.
Reload preserves live observations. Expired-session restoration keeps the earned Aluat recipe and starts empty failure history.
Local acknowledgment at20seconds does not renew freshness; the retry at31seconds reaches the server.
No page errors in any fresh browser scenario.
limits: Not human enjoyment testing or physical-device acceptance.
Failed-pair memory is deliberately session-local, capped128; portable saves keep successful discoveries only.
Previously observed failures may suppress a repeat for at most30seconds after successful state adoption; after that the server rechecks.
Actual compatible recipe addition and128-entry eviction were verified by the separate backend review, not fabricated as browser observations.
This feature review does not establish final V95 content installation or full-suite integration.
